arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib
module = importlib.import_module('jinja2.loaders')
actual=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
expected=(Path.cwd() / 'src/jinja2/loaders.py').resolve()
print("source_binding", str(actual), "sha256", hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
from jinja2 import DictLoader, Environment
from jinja2.exceptions import TemplateNotFound
mapping={"message":"first"}
loader=DictLoader(mapping)
env=Environment(loader=loader,auto_reload=True)
assert env.get_template("message").render()=="first"
_,_,up_to_date=loader.get_source(env,"message")
assert up_to_date()
mapping["message"]="second"
print("uptodate_after_update",up_to_date(),"rendered_after_update",env.get_template("message").render())
assert not up_to_date()
assert env.get_template("message").render()=="second"
del mapping["message"]
assert not up_to_date()
try: loader.get_source(env,"message")
except TemplateNotFound: pass
else: raise AssertionError("Missing template should raise TemplateNotFound")
PYREPLAY
